outcome: onset and duration of sensory and motor block
cohort: 100 consented patients undergoing lower segment caesarean section (LSCS).
finding: Intrathecal Chloroprocaine + Isobaric Ropivacaine + Fentanyl provided effective anesthesia for LSCS with shorter motor blockade duration and similar hemodynamic parameters and Apgar scores compared to Chloroprocaine + Hyperbaric Bupivacaine + Fentanyl.
